name: io.github.smdesai27/math-board
title: Math board
description: A local, view-only chalkboard the model draws on: equations, plots, molecules and diagrams.

environmentVariables.name: MATH_BOARD_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 and board_open only returns the board's URL instead of opening it in the default browser.

environmentVariables.name: MATH_BOARD_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder shared by pi and MCP sessions for the board autosave and named saves. A checkout defaults to <package>/.data; an installed package uses ~/Library/Application Support/math-board on macOS, $XDG_STATE_HOME/math-board or ~/.local/state/math-board on Linux, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\math-board on Windows. PI_MATH_BOARD_DATA_DIR is also accepted.
